{{Top|leg}}
'''''Spacers' Information Manual''''' was a manual provided to [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] automatically upon renewing their flight certification with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Imperial Space Ministry]]. It contained updates for the ''[[Imperial Spacefaring Regulations]]'' that all pilots were obliged to obey.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
